name: UF-dungeon-monster-darkest
note: Matches qb64-dungeon's default monster art: Pixel Art XL + darkest, 128x128. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/dungeon-monster-darkest.  (sample: seed 1056)

form.subject: a (monstrous dungeon rat:1.3), matted fur, (long yellow fangs:1.1), (glowing red eyes:1.2), (single creature:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (monstrous dungeon rat:1.3), matted fur, (long yellow fangs:1.1), (glowing red eyes:1.2), (single creature:1.2)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped' --style darkest --out 128x128 --palette none --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1056
